description: Launch an app on mobile device. Use this to open a specific app. You can find the package name of the app by calling mobile_list_apps.

arguments.description: Arguments to launch the app with, one per item. On iOS they are the app's process arguments, like Xcode's Arguments Passed On Launch (e.g., ["-FeatureX", "YES"]). On Android each item must be key=value and is passed as a string intent extra the app reads from its launch intent (e.g., ["featureX=true"])

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

environment.description: iOS only. Environment variables set for the app process (e.g., {"API_URL": "https://staging.example.com"})

locale.description: Comma-separated BCP 47 locale tags to launch the app with (e.g., fr-FR,en-GB)

packageName.description: The package name (Android) or bundle id (iOS) of the app to launch

name: mobile_launch_app
title: Launch App
